# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI is a one-person AI solutions architecture practice run by Damien Rosecraft. It designs and builds production architecture for large language models and agentic AI systems, and releases software products built in the spirit of effective acceleration (e/acc).

Source: https://lastelle.ai/
Last updated: 2026-10-26

## Intelligence synthesized by humans

AI architecture and agentic systems for organizations moving faster than their market, alongside products built in the spirit of effective acceleration.

Architecture that carries language models out of the pilot stage and into the work an organization runs on.

## Practice

Design and build work for production AI, plus products released under the Lastelle name.

### Solutions architecture

Designs fitted to the client's data. Reference architectures for model selection, retrieval, orchestration, and evaluation, matched to the client's stack and risk posture.

- Model and vendor selection
- Retrieval and memory design
- Evaluation harnesses

### Agentic systems

Agents that carry real work. Workflows of cooperating agents across Claude, OpenAI, and xAI, with human checkpoints placed where judgment matters.

- Orchestration layers
- Tool and data integration
- Human review checkpoints

### Products

Tools for people building the future. Software released under the Lastelle AI name to speed up the industries pushing technology forward.

- Built in the open
- Designed for self service
- Released as they mature

## Method

Every engagement ends in working software that the client owns outright.

1. Survey: A map of the client's data, systems, and constraints, and an agreed definition of what success will be measured against.
2. Architect: A reference design with the models, retrieval, orchestration, and controls chosen for the case.
3. Build and hand over: Working software in small, tested increments, delivered with documentation and evaluation harnesses so it keeps running on its own.

## About

One builder, from the first call to production.

Damien Rosecraft is an AI solutions architect working in technology since 2016, and he runs Lastelle AI on his own. The person who scopes a system is the same person who designs it, writes it, and stands behind it once it is live.

His work divides between architecture for organizations putting language models, agents, and automated pipelines into live operations, and products he releases himself to push the frontier faster.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thirdechelon

## FAQ

### What kind of work does Lastelle AI take on?

Solutions architecture and agentic systems for organizations putting language models into live operations, plus products released under the Lastelle AI name.

### Who does the work?

Damien Rosecraft, from the first call to production. Lastelle AI is a one person practice, so nothing is handed off to a team the client never met.

### Which models and platforms are supported?

Systems are built across Claude, OpenAI, and xAI, with the model chosen for each job rather than one vendor for everything.

### What do I own at the end of an engagement?

The working software, its documentation, and the evaluation harnesses that measure it. Ownership is clear from the start.

### Where do people stay in the loop?

Human checkpoints are placed wherever a decision needs judgment, and agents handle the rest.

### How quickly will I hear back?

Within two business days, with a first read on scope and architecture.
